keyPoints: Purak kon (complementary) ka yog 90 hota hai aur sampurak kon (supplementary) ka yog 180 — 30 ka purak 60, sampurak 150.
Aasann kon (adjacent) ka sheersh aur ek bhuja common hoti hai; rekhi yugm (linear pair) ke aasann konon ka yog 180 hota hai.
Sheershabhimukh kon (vertically opposite) barabar hote hain — do rekhaon ke kaatne par aamne-saamne ke kon same hote hain.
Tiryak rekha (transversal) do rekhaon ko kaate to 8 kon bante hain — sangat (corresponding) kon barabar hote hain jab rekhaen samantar hon — yehi gun samantar rekhaon ki pehchaan hai.
Ekantar (alternate) kon bhi samantar rekhaon me barabar hote hain, aur tiryak ke ek hi taraf ke antar konon ka yog 180 hota hai.
Samantar rekhaen kabhi nahi miltin, lamb rekhaen 90 par kaatti hain.
Aam galti: purak aur sampurak ko ulta yaad karna — pu chhota shabd, 90 chhota yog; sam bada, 180 bada yog.
subject: Maths
title: Rekhaen aur Kon
